t_advice_summary_textbox.text: look out for patterns, eg size or colour of hat on the gnome as this will help you get more mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: Take your time with the first dozen attempts to see if you can identify a pattern; for instance choosing a smaller wizard for x1 or a side left or right and also the colour of the wizards hat. for instances if there is a wizard with a colour on the left they might give you more mushrooms and then they don't if they appear on the right hand side.
